subject: OPERATOR DECISION (Frank/Nancy): lab containers have NO route to the OpenStack instance data plane (measured 2026-07-30: API reachable via bridge, 192.168.233.1 and 192.168.122.62 unreachable). With the 1-instance quota this blocks the core experience of 3 of 8 designed labs (security groups 'feel the timeout', full launch chain ending in SSH, Neutron floating-IP SSH). Options: (1) route the tenant subnet from bc1 -- needs a fresh netfilter review, exposes instances to bc1; (2) 2nd instance per student -- +5.8GB, blocked by capacity math; (3) ship API-only labs now and sequence connectivity labs after a routing decision (RECOMMENDED). See _docs/operations/openstack-sandbox-scoping.md.
